operations.body: Fix committed locally on fix/syncloop-status-race (not pushed). Reproduced about 1 in 1,200 runs under load. Five tests shared the race; waitForSyncs now waits on a new published seam in the watcher. Also hardened TestScheduledTickIsSuppressedWhileANudgeIsPending, which failed under heavy load in the same stress run. 100 full passes of the package at four in parallel are clean.
